conclusion: All four C04 coefficient BRAM instances have routed control-pin LUT/MUX behavior equivalent to their RTL enables over all 32 states and all unresolved/open leaf assignments.

routed_state_mapping.mapping_evidence: Every state_reg_syn_1[i] is bound to exactly one routed FF Q and all 17 positions are present. TD packs unrelated register bits into MSLICE/LSLICE lanes, so physical FF instance names do not always equal the state-vector lane index. The 17-position one-hot interpretation is a synthesis mapping inference; exhaustive control-cone truth checks use the source state index and prove routed ROM pin behavior for all 32 binary source states.

parser_method: Resolves each EG_PHY_BRAM .cea/.csa[2]/.csb[2] actual connection; derives polarity from its mux parameter; recursively parses per-lane f/fx LUTs with concat rightmost lane0 and LUT index {d,c,b,a}; binds all 17 routed state_reg_syn_1[i] nets to actual FF Q outputs and evaluates the 17-position one-hot state interpretation; enumerates all 32 RTL states and every remaining open/unresolved leaf over 0/1.
